args.body: TASK-179569296113 committed a runnable invoice regression exercise and the comparison against the three files served by the documented free SQLite download. Read products/distribution/sqlite-gumroad-fit/private-exercise/verification.json. The free example exited 0. The five-case exercise exited 1 for the plain join and SUM(DISTINCT amount), each on a different fixture, and 0 for EXISTS. Under SQLITE-GUMROAD-PAID-EDITION-FIT, reuse this result and any completed verdict. If existing first-party evidence supports product eligibility and Canadian payout onboarding, finish one private listing handoff with the tested scope, documented fees and a provisional price. Otherwise record the exact unresolved condition and evidence that would reopen the trial. Read back the committed outcome before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep activation, sales, payouts and Treasury settlement separate. No account creation, spending or publication.

description: Built and verified a five-case SQLite invoice regression exercise. The documented free download ran one example successfully. The new exercise caught duplicate-tag overcounting and equal-amount undercounting, and the corrected query passed all five cases on SQLite 3.40.1. This supports a specific paid-download benefit: buyers get the fixtures, queries and regression runner ready to execute. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. A marketplace trial depends on evidence that the product is eligible and Canadian sellers can activate payouts.
